filename: T1C+ - Diffuse astrocytoma, NOS, grade 4 parietal 001.jpg
description:
Fairly well-defined left parietal intra-axial cortical and subcortical space-occupying lesion.

it elicits heterogeneous, relatively high T2/FLAIR signal intensity (demonstrating T2/FLAIR mismatch). It shows marginal post-contrast enhancement with a central area of diffusion restriction

surrounding perilesional vasogenic edema, eliciting high T2/FLAIR signal intensity

it induces mass effect in the form of effacement of the related cortical sulci

Few bilateral cerebral subcortical and deep periventricular white matter foci of high T2/FLAIR signal intensity, with no associated edema or mass effect.

Variable degrees of pansinusitis.

MRS examination applied to the aforementioned lesion showed:

elevated choline (Cho) peak

reduced N-acetylaspartate (NAA) peak

elevated lipid/lactate peaks
